customer_mapping.description: Fields that specify how to map a meter event to a customer.

default_aggregation.description: The default settings to aggregate a meter's events with.

display_name.description: The meter’s name. Not visible to the customer.

event_name.description: The name of the meter event to record usage for. Corresponds with the `event_name` field on meter events.

event_time_window.description: The time window which meter events have been pre-aggregated for, if any.

expand.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.

value_settings.description: Fields that specify how to calculate a meter event's value.
